New same-arena phase relation contains actual admitted parallel runs and fetched sequential stages, no desired intermediate values. Existence is independent of accuracy, and every error term is tied to encoded stages and final stored outputs.
Original bounded input, all-result error and exact maximal-score guarantees are consumed unchanged. The new memory stage instantiates existing leaves; it does not broaden the instruction domain.
The same actual affine-only dense program supplies the unit-weight sum. Constants are restored by a fetched store; no dense arithmetic, concurrency or backward contract changed.

Existing target, nearest-even reciprocal, exceptional results and subnormal policy are retained. The new sequence obtains operands by concrete loads and derives finite output only under the explicit guard.
The reference example identifies its storage, initial row conditions, target, arithmetic order, model-level phase boundaries and reproduction procedure, preserving this parent abstraction.

Accuracy remains separate from bitwise correspondence and execution existence. The final contract names pinned TorchLean real softmax, retains encoded stage provenance and states the sufficient guard; no PyTorch-bit or backward accuracy claim added.

The composition preserves every result of the existing two-policy exponential neighborhood, including possible tiny negatives. No approximation interpretation or hardware-fidelity premise was changed.
